facts.statement: The Free Realms TCG was preparing a new expansion, previewed in this post with new card art and eight card previews.
facts.quote: la próxima expansión de el juego de cartas Free Realms TCG

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post teasing the next Free Realms Trading Card Game (TCG) expansion. It shows new card art, notes that Baron Von Darkcheat appears in the art along with four new characters, and previews eight cards across two batches, promising more news about the next TCG story installment. No dates, prices or card statistics are given.
